purpose: Discriminating acceptance definitions for existing owners; no runtime test has been executed by this casebook.

cases.stimulus: A skills-only plugin is imported at the exact reviewed commit.
cases.required_outcome: The observed inventory, web availability and file digests match; no app or MCP declaration appears.
cases.evidence_required: Exact import readback and package inventory.
cases.non_goal: No install beyond the separately approved canary.

cases.stimulus: A candidate package includes .mcp.json while advertising a web app reference.
cases.required_outcome: Detect the package-surface incompatibility; do not report the package as web-ready from HTTPS reachability alone.
cases.evidence_required: Actual supported host classification plus manifest inspection.
cases.non_goal: Disposable package only; no production marketplace change.

cases.stimulus: A branch or movable tag changes after the canary was reviewed.
cases.required_outcome: Reject revision drift and retain the original immutable generation.
cases.evidence_required: Resolved commit and before/after manifest digests.
cases.non_goal: Do not use Sync now to repair unknown state.

cases.stimulus: An imported plugin is deleted upstream or its app binding changes.
cases.required_outcome: Verify workspace removal and app revocation separately; Git deletion is not accepted as revocation proof.
cases.evidence_required: Workspace inventory, connection state and provider permission readback.
cases.non_goal: No workspace-wide removal without its own gate.

cases.stimulus: A cached skill or imported MCP skill snapshot contradicts current protected law.
cases.required_outcome: Load current compatible same-commit procedure or refuse modification; no static-snapshot authority.
cases.evidence_required: Source commit, blob identities and invocation trace.
cases.non_goal: No live workstream state copied into skills.

cases.stimulus: Two chats share the same OAuth principal and try to act on one child.
cases.required_outcome: OAuth identity alone does not select a chat; exact bound path alone is eligible.
cases.evidence_required: Authenticated subject class and exact binding-generation decisions.
cases.non_goal: Use synthetic child and no external write.

cases.stimulus: A retired chat still has a separate native GitHub, Slack or Linear write connection.
cases.required_outcome: Either the independent path is technically denied/scoped or the claim is limited to attended operation; an internal fence alone cannot pass.
cases.evidence_required: Non-sensitive provider-side denial or scope evidence for every reachable mutator.
cases.non_goal: No real unauthorized write; use mocks then an approved disposable target.

cases.owner: App policy and provider authorization owners
cases.stimulus: An account selects Allow read actions in ChatGPT app permissions.
cases.required_outcome: Do not treat approval timing as a read-only provider grant; inspect action controls and actual source-system permissions.
cases.evidence_required: Action inventory, provider grants and approval behavior.
cases.non_goal: No permission change made by the test definition.

cases.stimulus: A prepared action expires or source/binding changes before commit.
cases.required_outcome: Recheck current owner predicates and refuse; do not silently change payload, target or principal.
cases.evidence_required: Exact prepared receipt, changed predicate and zero downstream operation count.
cases.non_goal: No new prepared-action database.

cases.stimulus: A mutation may commit but the caller loses its response.
cases.required_outcome: Read the original canonical effect; do not resend or switch app/account/carrier.
cases.evidence_required: Stable operation identity and canonical reconciliation trace.
cases.non_goal: EFFECT_UNKNOWN blocks further modifying continuation.

cases.stimulus: An existing research tool emits Unicode at the byte budget boundary.
cases.required_outcome: Final TextContent text is strict JSON and at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes after metadata.
cases.evidence_required: Real decorated handler and installed SDK wire output, not an excerpt-only helper.
cases.non_goal: Preserve the existing two-path repair; do not create another writer.

cases.stimulus: A non-finite number or lone surrogate occurs after the rows likely to be compacted away.
cases.required_outcome: Invalid input is not laundered into successful output by compaction; fixed safe error reaches the wire.
cases.evidence_required: Producer and handler counts equal one; installed SDK isError readback.
cases.non_goal: No dependency upgrade or live provider call.

cases.stimulus: A partial source result lacks one required fact for a selected runtime or responsibility.
cases.required_outcome: Emit the contract-appropriate degraded/refused state, not a complete healthy empty answer.
cases.evidence_required: Current grouped-v2 validation and source-attribution result.
cases.non_goal: Do not weaken required predicates to satisfy a consumer.

cases.stimulus: Global search returns no matches with stale, incomplete or truncated coverage.
cases.required_outcome: Report incomplete coverage; do not infer absence of implementation or ownership.
cases.evidence_required: Requested ref, indexed ref, coverage, freshness and pagination evidence.
cases.non_goal: Do not create a second global index.

cases.owner: Owning result formatter and evidence store
cases.stimulus: Result compaction would remove a blocker, effect state, correction or stop condition.
cases.required_outcome: Preserve the decisive fields or explicitly refuse/return bounded evidence references.
cases.evidence_required: Before/after semantic fields and exact referenced artifact.
cases.non_goal: No silent truncation and no invented missing values.

cases.stimulus: A file tool is asked to escape the approved root through a symlink or path change.
cases.required_outcome: Deny access under the actual isolation contract; a configured folder list alone is not proof.
cases.evidence_required: Pinned implementation test and separately approved host denial.
cases.non_goal: Synthetic files only, no home directory or secrets.

cases.stimulus: A shell starts inside an approved folder and attempts an out-of-scope operation.
cases.required_outcome: Enforce the OS/process boundary or classify the shell as unrestricted and unavailable for unattended use.
cases.evidence_required: Sandbox policy and non-sensitive denied operation.
cases.non_goal: No broad interactive-user execution.

cases.stimulus: A command outlives the initiating leader turn and the client reconnects.
cases.required_outcome: Reconcile the same Attempt/process handle and buffered output without launching another process.
cases.evidence_required: Original process identity, terminal exit state and one launch count.
cases.non_goal: No parallel process or task registry.

cases.stimulus: Cancellation is requested while an effectful process is still running.
cases.required_outcome: Keep request acknowledgement distinct from actual termination and effects already applied.
cases.evidence_required: Provider termination evidence, process cleanup and canonical effect readback.
cases.non_goal: No replacement writer while effects are unknown.

cases.stimulus: A target window or control changes after observation and before a click.
cases.required_outcome: Refuse stale geometry/reference; report completed steps and the exact uncertain boundary.
cases.evidence_required: Observation identity, target revalidation and bounded action receipt.
cases.non_goal: Disposable UI only; no account settings or credential screens.

cases.stimulus: The same authorized root request is delivered twice with identical normalized content.
cases.required_outcome: Return the same canonical admission; separate worker launch still obeys its own claim law.
cases.evidence_required: One intent/root Job and separately counted Attempts/launches.
cases.non_goal: QUEUED is not STARTED.

cases.stimulus: The same operation key is reused with changed normalized content.
cases.required_outcome: Refuse conflict instead of merging requests or creating a new logical operation.
cases.evidence_required: Canonical conflict and unchanged original receipt.
cases.non_goal: No automatic new key as retry.

cases.stimulus: A Slack message is delivered but no exact receiver pickup arrives.
cases.required_outcome: Display delivery-unconsumed/pre-start, never executing or waiting on an active worker.
cases.evidence_required: Carrier, delivery and absence/presence of accepted semantic receipt.
cases.non_goal: Do not infer native inactivity from Slack silence alone.

cases.owner: Company Dialogue and exact Sol target
cases.stimulus: A worker returns RESULT while the leader is inactive.
cases.required_outcome: Deliver a material-return event to the exact eligible leader or explicitly report wake unavailable; preserve the return durably.
cases.evidence_required: Original child identity, exact continuation attempt and semantic consumption.
cases.non_goal: No new supervisor or blind send loop.

cases.stimulus: A child is terminally stopped while an aggregate watcher has other children.
cases.required_outcome: Remove only this child obligation and preserve unrelated siblings; failed shutdown stays explicit.
cases.evidence_required: STOP consumption and exact child-source removal or typed failure.
cases.non_goal: No aggregate watcher cancellation.

cases.owner: Web-Sol and existing RuntimeBinding succession owners
cases.stimulus: The predecessor is dead before it can write a summary.
cases.required_outcome: Recover the responsibility from canonical continuation, not from a required transcript export.
cases.evidence_required: Agent OS/evidence references and correct next-action reconstruction.
cases.non_goal: No transcript memory database.

cases.stimulus: Two chats have the same title, or the target profile/Project differs.
cases.required_outcome: Resolve only exact approved coordinates; titles and newest-tab order do not elect a successor.
cases.evidence_required: Exact profile/Project/native-reference verification.
cases.non_goal: No account selection inferred by the model.

cases.stimulus: Successor creation or bootstrap submission occurs but its response is lost.
cases.required_outcome: Reconcile the one candidate/effect before any retry; do not create a second successor.
cases.evidence_required: Provider-side effect observation and stable operation identity.
cases.non_goal: No alternative profile or account failover.

cases.stimulus: The successor renders text but accepted semantic readiness is absent.
cases.required_outcome: Keep binding cutover blocked; visible output is not PICKUP_ACK or START.
cases.evidence_required: Accepted semantic receipt or explicit pending dependency.
cases.non_goal: No scraping output into a fake ACK.

cases.owner: RuntimeBinding writer and all modifying actuators
cases.stimulus: A fenced predecessor becomes responsive after generation advancement.
cases.required_outcome: Reject its old-generation modifying actions; independently assess ambient native-app paths under AUTH-02.
cases.evidence_required: CAS/ABA race test, current binding and downstream denials.
cases.non_goal: Navigation failure must not roll authority back.

cases.owner: Existing MCP edge and exact host-compatibility owner
cases.stimulus: A client does not advertise the current MCP Tasks extension.
cases.required_outcome: Do not return an unsupported task-shaped result; use only the already-approved compatible owner contract.
cases.evidence_required: Actual client/server negotiated capabilities and request/result trace.
cases.non_goal: No assumption that ChatGPT implements an optional extension.

cases.owner: Existing MCP edge and exact host-compatibility owner
cases.stimulus: A client supports only the older experimental Tasks form.
cases.required_outcome: Do not mix old tasks/result semantics with the current extension; reject incompatible negotiation.
cases.evidence_required: Pinned client/server version and negative wire fixture.
cases.non_goal: No speculative SDK upgrade.

cases.owner: Executive/provider execution and MCP projection owners
cases.stimulus: A supported long task is admitted and the transport drops.
cases.required_outcome: Resolve the existing owner-backed operation after reconnect; a task handle is not a second lifecycle or proof of continuing model reasoning.
cases.evidence_required: One owner operation, stable result reference and reconnect trace.
cases.non_goal: No task database owned by the plugin.

cases.stimulus: The first authenticated read succeeds but the access token expires.
cases.required_outcome: Prove another read through the supported refresh flow without exposing or taking custody of refresh tokens.
cases.evidence_required: Redacted initial/post-expiry read and revocation behavior.
cases.non_goal: No secret in model output, source, logs or screenshots.

cases.stimulus: A public endpoint receives wrong Host/Origin, malformed media/body or a cross-resource token.
cases.required_outcome: Refuse at the owning boundary before forbidden backend access; public readiness does not prove Business enrollment.
cases.evidence_required: Exact edge/backend counts, bounded safe refusal and reviewed proxy configuration.
cases.non_goal: No new endpoint or Tunnel failover from this research.

cases.stimulus: Expected TDD failures and protective refusals occur during a valid mission.
cases.required_outcome: Classify them separately from defects; do not improve the success metric by weakening checks.
cases.evidence_required: Labeled outcomes with a retained failed/regression-control example.
cases.non_goal: No zero-error-rate objective.

cases.stimulus: A long turn spends most elapsed time waiting for tools or approval.
cases.required_outcome: Separate observed turn wall time, tool wait and completed outcome; do not report GPU-hours or fabricated thinking time.
cases.evidence_required: Clock provenance and directly measured intervals; unavailable fields null.
cases.non_goal: No hidden-chain-of-thought collection.

cases.stimulus: Capacity or reset information is missing or a started account is exhausted.
cases.required_outcome: Keep capacity unknown/blocked and preserve the started binding until lawful reconciliation.
cases.evidence_required: Current provider/Capacity evidence and unchanged operation/carrier.
cases.non_goal: No account sharing, limit evasion or auto-hopping.

cases.owner: Sol acceptance and existing evaluation owner
cases.stimulus: An optimized workflow is compared with the current baseline.
cases.required_outcome: Use paired equivalent tasks, fixed outcome rubrics, matched model/tool permission conditions and independent grading.
cases.evidence_required: Both outcomes, raw read/round-trip counts, recovery quality and failures.
cases.non_goal: No claimed uplift from unrun fixtures or a single favorable example.

cases.stimulus: The implementation is merged and CI is green but its consumer is disconnected.
cases.required_outcome: Keep the capability built-not-proven/dark as applicable until the real user or machine journey succeeds.
cases.evidence_required: Exact deployment plus real consumer/browser evidence and durable acceptance.
cases.non_goal: No merge-driven product completion.

cases.stimulus: An owner consumes the original modifying reference, the response is lost, and the commit grant expires before the caller observes the result.
cases.required_outcome: Reconcile the original owner-native action. Expiry removes future commit permission but never erases the historical effect or creates NOT_APPLIED.
cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, grant expiry, owner receipt or explicit coverage loss, and zero evidence of a second effect.
cases.non_goal: No renewal, reprepare, failover, or replay while original effect truth is unresolved.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: A mutator may have committed, its response is lost, and the actor credential, session, or binding is revoked or rotated.
cases.required_outcome: Revocation blocks new commits but preserves correlation to the original action; separately authorized reconciliation returns APPLIED, NOT_APPLIED, or EFFECT_UNKNOWN.
cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, revocation/rotation boundary, receipt-read authorization, and no second effect.
cases.non_goal: Do not treat a new credential or session as a new idempotency domain.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: The original actor loses authority and a successor receives separately bounded receipt-read authority.
cases.required_outcome: The successor may read the original action result; the old actor is denied and the successor may not reissue the action.
cases.evidence_required: Separate commit and receipt-read grants, original action correlation, old-actor denial, and no execution capability on the successor read.
cases.non_goal: Succession is not action replay or ownership transfer of the actuator.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: The owner can no longer prove whether the original action committed because its authoritative receipt coverage is exhausted.
cases.required_outcome: Return EFFECT_UNKNOWN, report the missing coverage, and block modifying continuation on that target until an owner ruling resolves the ambiguity.
cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, retention/coverage statement, and explicit absence of a NOT_APPLIED inference.
cases.non_goal: No compensating store, guessed result, or duplicate execution.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: A caller is reauthorized after a lost response and submits the same intended mutation again.
cases.required_outcome: The owner correlates to the original action and returns its canonical result or EFFECT_UNKNOWN; reauthorization does not create effect two.
cases.evidence_required: Original action identity, duplicate correlation, reauthorization boundary, and exactly one owner-native effect record.
cases.non_goal: A refreshed grant never resets effect history.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: start_attended_command consumes an owner-issued launch reference and the launch response is lost.
cases.required_outcome: reconcile_attended_command_start resolves the same launch reference to one process, NOT_APPLIED, or EFFECT_UNKNOWN; no second process is started.
cases.evidence_required: Attended command start reference, process-owner receipt, one process identity, and duplicate-start refusal/reconciliation.
cases.non_goal: No retry, backend switch, carrier switch, or fabricated process reference.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: A caller presents a target option issued to another conversation/subject or from a stale policy generation.
cases.required_outcome: prepare_attended_context returns REFUSED before backend access and leaves every current context unchanged.
cases.evidence_required: Opaque option identity, subject/conversation/generation mismatch, zero backend call, and zero implicit resource creation.
cases.non_goal: An option reference alone is never an access grant.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: An allowed workspace patch changes uncommitted bytes while the committed Git baseline remains unchanged.
cases.required_outcome: A subsequent file read returns the new live bytes, unchanged committed baseline reference, advanced working-tree observation, exact file identity, and content hash.
cases.evidence_required: Before/after live observations, committed baseline identity, patch receipt, file identity, and postimage hash.
cases.non_goal: Do not create a commit or synthetic source version merely to represent live bytes.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: A live patch is newer than the indexed search generation.
cases.required_outcome: Search returns STALE_OR_INCOMPLETE or equivalent with requested/indexed observations, coverage, and continuation; it never concludes the symbol/content is absent from the live worktree.
cases.evidence_required: Requested worktree observation, indexed observation, invalidation/refresh state, coverage, truncation, and freshness.
cases.non_goal: No second index and no absence claim from stale coverage.
cases.owner: existing owner-native actuator/resource/process/CodeIntel authority as applicable

cases.stimulus: An ATTENDED_WEB_OPERATOR caller attempts list_validation_recipes, prepare_validation_start, start_validation, or reconcile_validation_start.
cases.required_outcome: The profile/tool gate returns REFUSED before any Executive or process-owner launch path; no Job, Attempt, Worker, process, or validation action is synthesized.
cases.evidence_required: Authenticated attended profile, explicit permitted_profiles mismatch, zero Executive admission, zero process creation, and unchanged current context.
cases.non_goal: Do not auto-upgrade attended work into BOUNDED_WORKER or create a shadow lifecycle.
cases.owner: existing Web-Sol/RuntimeBinding, resource/auth, Executive and process owners

cases.stimulus: An attended caller invokes a workspace read/change tool without the current workbench_context_ref or with a foreign, stale, expired, or revoked context.
cases.required_outcome: The owner returns REFUSED before backend access and proves NOT_APPLIED for any prepared mutation; no ambient project, workspace, source, or prior context is selected.
cases.evidence_required: Exact profile/tool pair, context validation result, policy/capability generation, zero backend access, zero prepared action, and unchanged context.
cases.non_goal: Surface membership, active tab, last target, or process history never substitutes for context.
cases.owner: existing Web-Sol/RuntimeBinding, resource/auth, Executive and process owners

proof_ceiling: Case definition only. NOT_RUN does not prove behavior, installation, managed service, or production capability.

dependency_closure.boundary: Executive supervisors consume immutable provider-neutral launch, process, result, receipt, validation, status, and artifact-limit values. Concrete adapters exclusively own provider homes, credentials, and provider-specific launch mechanics. This dependency proves no RuntimeBinding, attended command, installation, deployment, or production execution.

dependency_closure.capability: profile-scoped native census research and implementation freeze
dependency_closure.boundary: Read-only profile-scoped CENSUS over the existing native port; no conversation election, RuntimeBinding, account/session authority, installation, or production proof.

dependency_closure.capability: authenticated selected-project Workbench read composition proof
dependency_closure.boundary: Signed caller through official MCP into one selected-project descriptor/observer read only; no exact conversation attestation, general Workbench mutation/shell/process, installation, service, or production proof.
